note: The helper stock's IDS, and nothing but ids (the creator, 2026-11-12: "never copy amounts from the config into code"; ECON-08): one copy, read by src/net/helpers.ts, src/net/rewards.ts, src/net/vip.ts, the win checker (functions/checker/build.rs) and tools/server/make-config.mts, and held to gem-backend-game-config.yaml by tools/server/helpers-check.mts. NO FIGURE IS HERE: each helper's cap is its currency's max_balance, what a buy, a pack or a bundle grants is its recipe's, the Starter Kit's once-only is its recipe's max_uses, and every price is the config's; the game reads them all in its gem.gameConfig.load() (src/net/helpers.ts readConfig). What a reward gives is the config's too (tools/server/helper-rewards.json, the generator's), read by the game from the platform's preview and by the checker from the receipt. `kinds`: each helper's currency, its use recipe, and its two buy recipes (`buy` the single, `buy3` the pack: names, never sizes). `rewards`: the server-only recipes the win checker runs (docs/vip.md): `kit` once ever, `hard` and `stamp` on a campaign board's first win, `daily` the daily puzzle's first win by the player's weekday (Monday first, ISO 1..7), `vipGift` VIP's gift by weekday (Monday first), `vipWelcome` VIP's welcome, once per player ever, whose `welcomeItem` is the account-bound marker it grants. `kit.progression`: the kit's mark, set by the kit's recipe. `oldMarks.welcomeEnd`, `oldMarks.dayMark`: the marks checkers before 0.1.63 raised; the welcome mark is still read (a player welcomed by one of them is not welcomed again), the day mark by nothing. `bundles`: the bundles' recipes, in shop order (name, slug, id).
